title: AI Book Cover Generator
summary: Free AI book cover generator: describe your story and get cover art for a novel, fantasy, romance, thriller or picture book, with room for your title.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI book cover generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made the covers here, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### Can AI put the title and author name on a book cover?


Yes. GPT Image 2.6 can letter a short title and name when you write them in capitals, say where they go and name the lettering style; check every letter at full size, since a misspelling is easy to miss.


### What size should an AI book cover be?


The lighthouse cover in the steps was made at 3:4; most ebook covers and print trims such as 6 by 9 inches are taller, so leave extra sky above and ground below the subject to crop to the exact size.


### Can I make a book cover from my story idea?


Yes. Describe the genre, one image that sums up the story, such as a lighthouse in fog or a dragon on a citadel, and the mood, rather than the whole plot, since a cover shows one moment.


### Can I keep the same characters across a book series?


Yes. Add the first cover as a reference image and describe the same character and style in a new scene; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so a whole series can share one look.


### Can I use an AI book cover on Amazon KDP?


Amazon KDP accepts covers made with AI, and asks you to say so when you publish; check the current rules of your store or publisher before you upload.


### Can I turn a book cover into a video?


Yes. Use the cover as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as fog drifting or a candle flickering, to make a moving cover or the opening of a book trailer.
